snippet.title: Umbrella Academy With And Without CGI
snippet.description:
The Umbrella Academy has some high powered scenes, brought on by the Hargreeves family unleashing their unique set of powers. A lot of CGI was used to create the stunning visuals we see on screen. The VFX team had their hands full for this show. From fully CGI chimpanzees, to jelly like effects, The Umbrella Academy wouldn’t be the same without the incredibly talented VFX teams that worked on the show. Some scenes look completely different without any visual effects, while for other scenes you may be surprised to learn how much was actually practical. There was one character that required two actors to bring to life! Who do you think it was?

When you have an entire house full of super powered individuals, there is bound to be plenty of CGI effects. Even something that may seem simple, like five teleporting through time, actually took a lot of research and development from the VFX team to get just right. And characters like AJ and Pogo are obviously created with CGI, but just how much? One of them was created with a lot more practical effects than you may think!

When you see the behind the scenes work that went into creating The umbrella Academy, you will begin to appreciate every scene. From the prop makers to the CGi artists, it all came together to create the visually beautiful show we have now.

Which scene do you think had the most impressive visual effects? Let us know down in the comment section below!

snippet.title: 15 Stranger Things Scenes The Actors Were Terrified To Film
snippet.description:
Stranger Things season Four is the stuff that nightmares are made of! We were terrified just watching, we can’t imagine the struggle the actors faced while filming these chilling moments. With the penultimate season being described as the darkest one yet - you’ll wanna make sure you have the lights on while you watch!
Sadie Sink has been stealing the show as Max - especially because she so bravely faced some of the most terrifying situations we’ve ever seen on the show! Her escape from Vecna was far from easy, but our girl kept running up that hill. No one likes a Demogorgon, even if you’ve dealt with one before, so seeing this freaky creature again brought back some trauma. Remember - these kids were young when they started and that creature was HORRIFYING. 
We get stunts galore in this season - including an intense underwater one that Joe Keery literally dove into headfirst. Filming in a tank filled with gallons of water was no walk in the park. He wasn’t the only one to struggle with underwater scenes - which scary moment in an earlier season had the production shaken up? Speaking of brutal conditions - David Harbour faces an excruciatingly tough scene to film that saw his feet freezing in a not-so-friendly environment. Millie Bobby Brown’s Eleven has it tough on screen, and this trooper had it equally rough behind the scenes filming certain stunts that had her literally spinning out of control!
The series just gets scarier as the actors grow up - we can’t imagine what kind of horrors we’ll see when the series wraps with its fifth season!

snippet.title: Sadie Sink Growing Up On The Stranger Things Set
snippet.description:
Sadie Sink has stolen the show in Stranger Things season 4. We’re so glad they finally leaned into her arc and gave her a chance to shine. So we thought this would be a good time to reflect on her time in the Stranger Things cast. It’s hard to believe now that she hasn’t been here since the beginning, only showing up in season 2 because she fits right in with the gang! Did you know her first kiss happened on set? Talk about awkward… Or was it? She and Millie Bobby Brown, in a rather spooky moment of filming, made up a dance to reflect their ketchup and mustard-coloured raincoats. Where can we buy one of those? She was getting friendly with some dogs on set. She is an animal lover through and through! She loved being able to work with the real Vecna and not some guy in a green suit. Thank you Jamie Campbell Bower for sitting in the makeup chair for six hours! While Sadie got to walk in and walk right on set. Getting ready for her took no time at all. She’s an odd duck. Weird things fascinate her like ants, quesadillas, and her co-stars Gaten Matarazzo and Caleb McLaughlin. Did you know she was terrified of Stranger Things when she first watched the show? We assume she watched it for research purposes because she hates scary movies and shows. It must’ve been a relief come season 3 when the costumes were so colourful and the sun was shining. Just watch her grow up on the set of Stranger Things before your very eyes. She’s funny. She’s a fashion icon. She’s an activist. We love her.

snippet.title: Disney's Lightyear Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
Disney Pixar’s Lightyear is finally hitting the big screen - and we cannot wait to see what Chris Evans has done with Buzz Lightyear. With this behind-the-scenes look at the making of this feature - we were super surprised to see all the work that was put in - even the smallest details.
So many new additions are making their way to the Toy Story universe - with Keke Palmer and Uzo Aduba fighting alongside Chris Evans - we’re sure it's going to be one of the most ambitious animations to date. But to earn that title - you got to take care of our Buzz Lightyear. He’s not only a big deal to us - but more for Director Angus MacLane - who’s been pushing Buzz along since Toy Story 2. And we can be sure that he’s making sure to add as many throwbacks as possible - while also introducing cool new tech to the mix. Oh and in case you all we’re wondering - the Snood may not be one of those throwbacks we hoped for. Before it was revealed - we thought Tim Allen being passed up to play his title role was an atrocity. But now we know - it’s not really the Lightyear we grew up with. This one has got a lot less plastic on him.
Everyone was so surprised with Pixar’s newest film - and the cast - well they’re a little too excited for us to say the least. So who’s ready to go to infinity and beyond? Strap in - we’re going on a whole lot of adventure here.

snippet.title: 12 Props the Stranger Things Actors Stole from Set
snippet.description:
Everyone loves to keep some mementos from sets they’ve worked on, but the ways they get them sometimes aren’t so honorable. The Stranger Things actors had all kinds of cool stuff to swipe from the set - but what did they take - and who was willing to risk it?! 
Some actors have been VERY tightlipped about their stealing habits, only letting us know something was swiped, but never specifying anything, just keeping the mystery alive. Noah Schnapp stole a pretty useful prop - and he made them even better by having the cast autograph them. Millie Bobby Brown stole a prop that could also come in useful - but in a very different way. If we’re being honest, it’s a pretty creepy one! 
The young actors are paid pretty well, but that didn’t stop them from stealing some weird necessities from the wardrobe department. Millie Bobby Brown took all that a step further when she had a little shopping spree at the Starcourt Mall - on the dime of the production. Sadie Sink swiper her own bit of clothing as well - although she does protest that it was a total accident.
Millie Bobby Brown has also swiped mementos from the sets of Enola Holmes and a tv show she did in her early days. Some items make total sense while others surprise us, but she had a pretty valid reason for each of them.
No matter how big or small, cheap or expensive, nothing was going to stop these actors from getting to keep what they wanted from the set- even if they did have to do it pretty sneakily at times!

snippet.title: Obi-Wan Kenobi Behind The Scenes Secrets
snippet.description:
We are taking a peek at what was going on behind the scenes of Obi-Wan Kenobi. We should have guessed Disney would go a little crazy with the Star Wars content eventually. Baby Yoda. Boba-Fett. Mando. Of course we get an Obi-Wan Kenobi story. Is anybody else afraid too much content may make the movies lose their luster? No? Okay, cool. We can’t wait for the Family Guy parody! After all the critics trashed the prequels so hard, Ewan McGregor is just happy to see that the next generation are fans. It rejuvenated him to come back. The lesson is to keep being kind if you want more Star Wars content. The new technology is a game-changer. Slowly green and blue screens are being phased out for the awesome StageCraft tech. Actors get to live in the world a little more now. The actors had to go to Jedi school in order to hone their fighting skills. Ewan dropped his lightsaber. Nobody tell Hayden Christensen he’s always being sassed by Ewan! The Grand Inquisitor finds himself juicy. Context is probably important so watch the video. Running across walls wireless happened. We’re not talking about phone lines here. Ewan struggled to find the voice of his character. He watched the movies and observed Alec Guiness’ performance of the character. One of the actors was a wee bit of a reckless driver and might’ve cut somebody else in the cast off who stopped for yellow lights. All this and more in the video.

snippet.title: 12 Dangerous Scenes Millie Bobby Brown Had to Film
snippet.description:
Millie Bobby Brown has a penchant for getting herself into danger on set. But we don't think a lot of it was her fault and even could have been avoided if there was better preparation before shooting. Prior to filming one season of Stranger Things, she broke her knee and couldn't do any of her own stunts. That one was definitely on her. Her corset was giving her a ton of problems, especially when it came to fight scenes. Didn't need to be a problem but it was. She was dropped in freezing cold water and fake-drowned for Enola Holmes. One had a simple answer, the other was handled safely. She destroyed her vocal cords. That ones probably unavoidable in a horror thriller show. She overworked herself to collapse. definitely avoidable. She was slammed into a wall, repeatedly. We didn't even mention all the things that put her in an awful state of mind. Vecna was one of them. She was terrified to tears. Eleven reuniting with Kali put her in so much of a mood she dragged her work home with her. Being bullied in the Rink-O-Mania just wrecked her and Noah Schnapp, too. We think Millie might be a bit Hollywood method. Being so young, it may be because her technique all comes from experience and less from training which could be remedied with time. Even still, we worry about her health when we hear she is pushing herself so far she's falling over. At least the nose bleeds aren't real.

snippet.title: Stranger Things Cast On The Season 4 Set
snippet.description:
Stranger Things Season 4 was a party behind the scenes. Seriously, it looks like there wasn’t a dull moment on this set which is such a jarring realization given the show itself is so dark! There are plenty of pranks, games and terrifying prosthetics to keep the young cast entertained. Starting off with a dark one did you hear how Vecna made Millie Bobby Brown cry? That’s not the only time tears happened either, the extreme bullying scene was so intense it not only overwhelmed her but her co-star Noah Schnapp. And one other thing for Millie is she was sick and tired of shaving off all of her hair. Is fame even worth it if you have no hair? Sadie Sink got to try her hand at stunt work with that levitating scene. One actor, poor Christopher Strand, was completely restricted from talking, seeing and even moving his arms thanks to his prosthetics. They had to come up with a system for communicating. Then you’ve got Millie and Noah roller-skating, Caleb McLaughlin scored a basket while goofing around on set waiting to film the next scene, and Charlie Heaton and Eduardo Franco were drinking and golfing. Seriously this does not sound like work to us. It sounds like a big excuse to party. Well, two can play at that game. We’re going to write a script about people who hang out at the beach all day. And speaking of the beach, you’ll never guess how barefoot scenes are filmed. It’s so simple it’s obvious but we never even questioned it!

snippet.title: Ms Marvel Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
Ms. Marvel is here and her name is Iman Vellani - AKA the real-life Kamala Khan. Ms. Marvel marks a series full of cultures, new performers, and a whole lot of action. 
Iman Vellani’s journey to becoming a Marvel superhero was almost fated. The actress had even dressed up in her own, homemade Ms. Marvel costume for Halloween - so she was well prepared to step into the role. From finding out she got the role on her last day of school with a Kevin Feige jump-scare, to FaceTiming with Brie Larson and having the real-life Captain Marvel as her mentor - well it was nothing short of a dream. Did we mention Vellani has NEVER acted professionally before?
Part of the fun and fluid vibe of the show comes from the fact that one of their directors encouraged the actors to improvise a whole lot before and after scenes. The fact that their first rehearsal was essentially just playing board games definitely helped with bringing those good vibes.
Iman Vellani may be green, but it didn’t stop her from bringing all her superhero moves - and you might notice some familiar poses on screen! The actress also dove headfirst into stunts and wire work! Vellani had some great support since she spent some time working out with Loki himself, Tom Hiddleston. That’s just what happens when you’ve got THREE Marvel productions filming on one lot in Atlanta. When they weren’t filming in their home studios though, adventures in London ensued - and it’s no surprise after all those amazing opportunities to bond that this cast and crew grew to be a true family. Ms. Marvel has talent, adventures, and a whole lot of fun - just like the team behind it!

snippet.title: Stranger Things Actors Who Were Rejected From Other Roles
snippet.description:
The Stranger Things Cast opened up about some of the important roles they auditioned for and didn’t land. So we’re taking a look at all the failed auditions that could’ve been life-changing. A Game of Thrones audition that didn’t go well was the second-to-last audition before one of the young cast was ready to quit acting. Stranger Things changed everything. Jamie Campbell-Bower who’s new to season 4 has been in his fair share of supernatural movies. But he once did a dazzling audition that got him nowhere… until the sequel. And speaking of razzle-dazzle, Chicago was one of many movies that one of the older cast members was rejected for. Titanic, Shakespeare in Love, Snow White and the Huntsman and Almost Famous were another few. Have you figured out who we're talking about? Millie Bobby Brown wasn’t the only one rejected for the X-Men franchise, poor David Harbour had a horrific experience at his audition. Half the cast of Stranger Things all kind of look similar thanks to them all going out for each other’s parts and being so good the Duffers cast them in other roles. The Duffers themselves struggled with even getting Stranger Things made. We bet every production company gave it one look and went, “You want how many children on set?” Did you know one new actor for Season 4 was rejected for the original Star Wars but paved the way for Mark Hamill to land his role as Luke Skywalker? We’ve got stories on Finn Wolfhard,  Noah Schnapp, Gaten Matarazzo, Joe Keery, Winona Ryder, Charlie Heaton and Joseph Quinn! Pretty much the whole cast has opened up about their failed auditions but they’re truly inspiring!

snippet.title: 10 Props The Jurassic World Actors Stole From Set
snippet.description:
When you’re in Jurassic World, it’s pretty hard NOT to swipe something cool! If we were in the cast of the Jurassic World or Jurassic movies, we’d definitely be wanting to keep some mementos - and it’s no surprise that the actors in these movies actually did!
We all know that feeling of finding a piece of clothing that fits just right, so when Chris Pratt discovered some epic pieces of clothing that felt oh-so-good to wear, there was no way he was leaving the set without them. A couple of the Jurassic World actors have walked a mile in their character's shoes - well more than a mile now since those character shoes became their shoes pretty quickly. How many pairs are we guessing were stolen from these sets in total?! Then, of course, there’s jewelry - and when you find a gem that shines just right, it’s hard to let go - just ask one of the Jurassic Park actors! Any guesses who?
In the Jurassic Park days, actors like Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum, and Sam Neill had no idea that they’d get to be in the Jurassic Franchise again, so they kept special props they loved from the set - even if they didn’t ask permission for them. 
Now, we all need to know - did anyone steal a dinosaur? You’ll have to watch to find out, but what we will say is that some of the actors from Jurassic Park do have actual dinosaurs in their homes - how did they end up there?! 
Leaving a set with some props and mementos so those memories can stay close makes sense, but some actors take it a bit overboard - but when you’re working in a franchise this cool - how can you blame them?!

snippet.title: Stranger Things Actors Painful Prosthetics In Season 4
snippet.description:
Stranger Things is a very niche show with niche injuries be they fake or real. Prosthetics can be so painful all the sensations blend together! Especially if you can’t see, talk or move, like what happened to Christopher Strand. Now, the Vecna prosthetic was of course a huge feat for the designers. The same designers by the way who designed the Night King for Game of Thrones. Landing the voice wasn’t all that easy for Jamie Campbell-Bower either! It’s pretty tough when you can’t hear yourself! Dacre’s gone through more prosthetic stickiness this season. After the lipgloss sitch before you’d think he’d be done with the prosthetics but nope! He must love them if he keeps going back to them. The white contacts were so trippy for the actors that the costume designer filmed it. Gaten Matarazzo absolutely loves his costumes but there’s one that was just too uncomfortable. Did we mention Dacre’s suffered from a ton of prosthetic-related incidents? Well, how about burns? Makeup can only do so much for you in the shower. One of the prosthetic Upside Down creatures was so painful to trundle around in that they actually replaced it with CGI. We wonder what happened to the actor… Joe Keery got beat up (in character of course) while he was feeling super sick (not so in character) and what the makeup department did lead to some irritation, to say the least. Noah Schnapp’s black contacts were a pest and so was the costume that wasn’t keeping him warm! And Nancy had the most unfortunate of events befall her after wearing the show makeup. Yes, filming this show is a lot of pain but hopefully worth it in the end!

snippet.title: The Boys Without CGI Effects
snippet.description:
It wouldn’t be a superhero show if there wasn’t some epic CGI involved - at least not any superhero shows we’ve seen before! The team behind The Boys actually did a ton of the stunts practically, doing the majority of the action for real on set - but the CG that was used was integral to making the show really shine.
Ok, so laser eyes? Those are definitely courtesy of VFX - and so too was the damage they did on other actors' faces - In combination with some very gruesome prosthetics. 
Any fans of the show will know what we’re talking about when we bring up the scene that features a whale… yes THAT whale. The process behind building it all was extensive - featuring full previsual tests done, filming in a green screen studio, and a partial whale for Chace Crawford to ride AND - a fully built, practical whale - organs, blood, and all. The majority of the stunt was actually filmed practically, with CG adding the finishing touches to make the scene really pop. 
When buildings were exploding, they avoided doing too much real harm but building the settings up from scratch via CG - including practical building elements so that when it was time for them to explode, they would look as realistic as possible. Speaking of which - there was a special detail added with CG to look like a camera effect to help ground the show even more. 
Need a boat? Well, launching one out of the water can be a bit intense - so a minimal build stood in its place while CG made the boat what it was. This superhero show has CGI playing a super role - and it does so well!

snippet.title: The Making Of Moon Knight
snippet.description:
Moon Knight provided us with awesome action, unique characters, and great visuals. Everyone gave it their all into creating the show, and their efforts show up on screen. Oscar Isaac delivered an amazing performance and Steven Grant and Mark Spector. And Ethan Hawke gave a powerful performance as the flawed villain Arthur Harrow. So how did this show come together? Let's take a look behind the scenes to appreciate all the work that went into Moon Knight.

Recreating ancient Egypt and all of the culture that comes with it was no easy task. They had tons of artists and crew members that helped build and paint the sets. One set was so big it took up 5 blocks! And it also had over 200 extras on set for filming. Another set had over 140 pieces of artifacts that the crew made from scratch to replicate the Egyptian section of the British Museum. There is so much detail that went into these sets that you don't even get to see all of it on screen. That's true dedication to your craft!

The blend of CGI and practical effects is a big reason why Moon Knight looks as incredible as it does. Most of the sets and costumes were completely practical, which helped the VFX team reference something real when they did have to animate sequences. Creating the sets and costumes from scratch gave the crew freedom to be creative. The creation of both Moon Knight suits was a collaboration that resulted in what we saw on screen.

snippet.title: 15 Painful Stranger Things Scenes To Film
snippet.description:
Stranger Things is an intense TV show so it’s no surprise to hear that its young cast struggled to film it. It was downright painful at times. From emotional pain, like missing your friends to vomiting and stingy-burning pain, the struggles this cast endured were very specific to this show. Millie Bobby Brown, who plays Eleven, is not one to go easy on herself, and this led her down a few dark paths. One had her collapse out of sheer exhaustion and another made her vomit. Only one of these moments made it into the show, we bet you can guess! She was also contending with a broken knee which couldn’t have been a whole lot of fun. She watched from the sidelines as her stunt double frolicked in The Upside Down. Dacre Montgomery who plays Billy Hargrove is almost as intense as Millie. He shattered a window in one improvised moment but wasn’t as lucky as his co-star. His moment to shatter the glass ceiling just wasn’t right. Dacre had a deep dark secret hidden right beneath his millions of prosthetics. Both Noah Schnapp and Joe Keery’s eyes were burning thanks to some costume department choices. Running around as a Demogorgon sounds like fun… in theory. But in reality, it was very difficult to navigate the creature suit. And so the Demogorgon was replaced. Yes, Stranger Things sure has dealt with its fair share of overwhelming incidents. There are just too many to list. So why not give the video a watch?

snippet.title: Disney Animation Then Vs. Now
snippet.description:
November 1995 marks the first CGI film from Disney, or should we say Pixar’s Toy Story. Back in the day, the animation studios struggled with any sort of detail in their animations. They completely avoided animating humans at all costs and when they did, they, let’s face it, looked pretty terrible. As the animators of Toy Story admitted when they moved on to the second movie, they wanted to better differentiate the texture of the toys from the humans. They were successful and suddenly zits were possible! Is that a step forward? The portrait lens on our phone would say otherwise. Getting to movies like Encanto and Turning Red was a process that took years to perfect. Each movie seemed to advance at least one element. Tangled, Brave, Frozen and Moana paved the way for Encanto to be the first animated movie in history to feature every hair type. Cars developed lighting and reflection. Monster’s Inc. focused on the importance of fur. Music movies, Soul and Coco needed an upgrade to hand functionality for playing instruments. Broad-shouldered characters weren’t introduced until super-strength Mr. Incredible came along. Luca finally tackled what hand-drawn animated movies like The Little Mermaid and Cinderella couldn’t: transformation. Ratatouille made animated food look freaking delicious and Turning Red borrowed from Bao to make lettuce look appetizing. Even virtual reality is a reality at Disney! All of these individual elements lend themselves to less time devoted to creating the programs to create the art and give the animators more time to just do the creative work. Are you interested in seeing just how much Disney has changed over the years and how they got there? Check it out!

snippet.title: The Making Of Chip And Dale Rescue Rangers
snippet.description:
The legendary Chip and Dale are back - but you’ve NEVER seen them like this before. This production brings together the best of animation history with a new twist - and some new talents.
John Mulaney and Andy Samberg are the first to voice Chip and Dale in decades - and they brought a whole new and brilliant energy. Lots of time was in the booth and connecting with each other to bring the relationship together. They weren’t alone though. Some very special guests helped to show them just how to nail it. One of their co-stars was on set filming every day, but their experience was pretty different from the norm since they were pretty much the only actor on set all the time, acting opposite different models and markers! 
One of the best parts of this movie is spotting just how many different characters make it to the screen - especially beloved Disney classics AND characters from outside the animated Disney world. However, it wasn’t easy to make it all happen. The lawyers in this production had a VERY important role in making this a reality. This movie has been a long time coming since the production team had to jump through all kinds of hoops to convince Disney to agree to make the film and of course, to fund it. One very short clip featuring Seth Rogen was what sold Disney on the film and the rest was history - and that clip happens to have been sent straight to Disney Plus, meaning it might end up being released as a special feature! This blast from the past will fill all your nostalgic needs while reminding us of the rich and incredible history of animation.

snippet.title: Stranger Things Cast Most Embarrassing Moments on Set
snippet.description:
When the Stranger Things cast gets together, you know it’s bound to be a good time. That being said - there are plenty of embarrassing ones that the cast would probably rather we not know about - but for fun, we’re checking out some of the most fun moments from behind the scenes. 
Practical jokes are a regular occurrence on this set - and some of them were quite elaborate. Millie Bobby Brown enlisted the help of multiple cast and crew members to plan a sneak attack on co-star Noah Schnapp. For Schnapp, it was about time he got a taste of his own medicine, as he is known as one of the biggest jokesters on set. He even played a joke so intense with Millie Bobby Brown, that they made a crew member cry! Then there are the days on set that bodies do things you’d rather they didn’t - and when there’s a smell or sound associated with it, it’s pretty hard to avoid acknowledging completely. 
While we love the 80’s throwback styles, the actors aren’t necessarily a fan of certain styles that they have to take on - especially when it comes to undergarments. One actor has faced embarrassment after embarrassment by wearing all kinds of wigs that left them blushing with embarrassment! 
Professional standards are high on a major project like this, so when one of the leading actors failed to show up on time, delaying the whole production schedule as a result, well they weren’t holding their head up too high! No one wants to be the reason for filming delays!
From the funny to the awkward, these special embarrassing moments behind the scenes just go to show how much goes into the making of such a big production!
